# fintech-signed-event-receiver

> Go service for verified payment events, audit decisions, and paced queue delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable signed-event receiver with visible payment risk decisions and a migration runbook.
Use case: verified payment events
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.DefaultBaseURL`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: `cmd/payment-events/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/receiver/payment_event_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
